reason: A terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides chat session navigation, streaming transcripts, agent interaction, tool activity display, and inline approval handling while relying on the host runtime for execution.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供终端聊天界面，用于管理会话、发送消息、查看流式响应与工具活动并处理审批提示。
summaries.en: A terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness that manages sessions, sends messages, displays streamed responses and tool activity, and handles approval prompts.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for DeepSeek Harness
Creates and resumes agent sessions through the host runtime
Sends user follow-up messages to agents
Displays streamed assistant output, tool activity, todos, and session metrics
Presents inline approval prompts and forwards user approval responses
Persists supported interface settings through the host settings system
